name: io.github.pei-jz/jh-presentation
title: jh-presentation
description: AI-built HTML presentations: single-file decks with live diagrams, charts, editing and PDF export.

environmentVariables.name: JH_PRESENTATION_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Settings folder (brand, themes, templates); decks go here when the client has no workspace

environmentVariables.name: JH_PRESENTATION_DECKS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder name for decks inside the client's workspace (default: decks)

environmentVariables.name: JH_PRESENTATION_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to always save decks in the settings folder instead of the client's workspace

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to Chrome or Edge, if not installed in the default location
